statements.impact_statement: The finding is attributed to nanobot-ai metadata 0.1.0, but the redirect-time SSRF behavior described by the advisory is not present in this candidate's web_fetch path. The fix commit 545294c62c0947da40eb5b65288aaf02b5fdf632 is an ancestor of the candidate revision 3daabe20f4c6a7b5f26f2158b97dc2591905507b; comparison confirms nanobot/agent/tools/web.py and nanobot/security/network.py are unchanged since the D6 assessment. Redirects remain manual, each hop is validated, and requests use the pinned-DNS transport.
statements.action_statement: This assessment applies only to this image ID. Re-evaluate if the web_fetch redirect or DNS-pinning code changes, or if the image is rebuilt from a different source revision.
